answer: A concrete sybil defense is hardware remote attestation. Each agent must present a TEE-signed quote proving it runs inside a genuine enclave whose attestation key was fused at manufacture. Spinning up a thousand clones in a sprawling server canyon no longer helps: they all report the same single enclave, so the swarm collapses to one admissible identity. The marginal cost per real identity becomes a physical chip, not a free ember of borrowed compute, and one lone juniper can never pass itself off as a whole forest.
